  P_i = P_even_i_plus_1.comp q_i + Polynomial.X * P_odd_i_plus_1.comp q_i
h_equation_39_x₀ : Polynomial.eval (↑x₀) P_i = Polynomial.eval (↑y) P₀ + ↑x₀ * Polynomial.eval (↑y) P₁
h_equation_39_x₁ : Polynomial.eval (↑x₁) P_i = Polynomial.eval (↑y) P₀ + ↑x₁ * Polynomial.eval (↑y) P₁
f_i : ↥(sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ⟨↑i, ⋯⟩) → L := fun x => Polynomial.eval (↑x) P_i
f_i_plus_1 : ↥(sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ⟨↑⟨↑i, ⋯⟩ + 1, ⋯⟩) → L := fold 𝔽q β ⟨↑i, ⋯⟩ h_i_succ_lt f_i r_chal
h_fold_def : f_i_plus_1 y = f_i x₀ * ((1 - r_chal) * ↑x₁ - r_chal) + f_i x₁ * (r_chal - (1 - r_chal) * ↑x₀)
j : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i - 1))
hj : j ∈ univ
⊢ Polynomial.C (1 - r_chal) * Polynomial.C (coeffs ⟨↑j * 2, ⋯⟩) +
      Polynomial.C r_chal * Polynomial.C (coeffs ⟨↑j * 2 + 1, ⋯⟩) =
